title: Copy intermediate Razor nodes before a custom transformation
goal: Preserve an original custom Razor node while transforming a separate working tree; choose explicit copy boundaries and implement the protected CloneNode shell hook for a version-coupled compiler host.

selectionNotes: Advanced compiler host with the exact matching SDK dependency set.
Protected shell hook only; explicit public copy supports a closed HTML/token vocabulary, shares immutable annotation values and rejects unknown kinds.

runtime.reason: Run the current compiler host on its matching runtime family.

sdk.reason: The advanced host directly references this SDK compiler, utility and Roslyn closure. Requalify other toolsets deliberately.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical current sample language mode; the copy algorithm needs no C#15-only syntax.

packageAssets: SDK source-generators/Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Razor.Compiler.dll and Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.Utilities.Shared.dll; matching SDK Roslyn/bincore/Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.dll and Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.dll. No independent compiler NuGet package.
platforms: Managed compiler host; measured Windows x64. No native assets.
renderingModes: Razor generation and execution in the supplied literal-only MapTemplate host; no MVC, browser or IDE integration claim.
prerequisites: An advanced version-coupled custom Razor host; own the extension node and its acyclic HTML/token child vocabulary.
constraints: CloneNode is a protected shell hook. The recursive Clone entry point is internal; no supported public generic clone is taught.
CopyForTransform explicitly copies only HTML content and HTML tokens; unknown kinds fail. No arbitrary subtree, internal flag, alias, lazy-state or ABI preservation promise.
Custom annotation containers are copied while immutable MapNote/string/diagnostic values are shared. No compiler Annotations property exists in these exact artifacts.
stabilityLimitations: GA-targeted edition with RC2 execution only; SDK compiler integration is version coupled. Rebuild extensions together; no older-target backport or actual-GA guarantee.
